text: Most people assume working with AI is a simple transaction.
You type the perfect prompt, and the AI returns the perfect answer.
But that's only the start.
Think back to the best group project you've ever done in history class.
Your group didn't start with the perfect finished project.
You shared ideas, figured out what was missing, and improved it together.
That's the same way you should work with AI.
The group is smaller, just you and the AI,
but the best result still takes a conversation.
There are four distinct moves to this process.
Think, learn, start, and iterate.
The very first move is think.
Use AI as a thought partner.
Just like in that history project, you brainstorm ideas,
ask questions, suggest next steps, and help one another decide what works.
Bounce ideas back and forth, but remember that you make the final decisions.
Here is how that looks in practice.
You say, I'd like to earn money this summer by starting a small business.
Can we talk through what might fit me?
What are you already good at and what problems
to people around you regularly need help solving?
You reply, I'm good with dogs and teaching younger kids math.
The AI answers, that gives us three realistic directions.
Pet care, math tutoring, and a neighborhood errand service.
Which sounds most interesting to you, and which would be easiest to start?
The second move is learn.
During that history group project, some members probably knew more
about a specific subject than others.
If a group member didn't understand a concept, they asked the group.
Work with AI in the same way.
When something does not make sense, use the conversation to understand something new.
Ask follow-up questions, connect the idea to something you already know,
and check whether you understand it.
Then explain the idea back in your own words and ask what you missed.
Let's test it on a business concept.
You say, I might start a business this summer mowing lawns.
What is profit and how do I calculate it?
Explain it using simple numbers that apply to a lawn mowing business.
The AI answers, profit is the money left after you subtract every cost from your sales.
Your sales are $300.
Your total costs are $150, leaving you with $150 in profit.
The formula is sales minus costs equals profit.
The third move is start.
For the history project, the teacher gave your group a clear topic,
like what caused the Civil War?
You knew exactly where to begin, but real life isn't always that clear.
What if you face a big decision or issue and don't even know where to start?
In those moments, AI can help you find a place to begin.
Simply ask it for the first question.
For instance, you say, I need to start thinking about college,
but I don't know where to begin.
Ask me one question at a time to help me figure out what matters to me.
Don't recommend a college yet.
Do you already have a career or field in mind,
or do you want college to help you explore different possibilities?
The fourth move is iterate.
That history group project lasted four weeks.
At the end of week one, your project was only average.
Each week, the group made it better and better.
By the time you presented it to the class, it was a masterpiece.
To iterate means to build something inversions,
using each version to improve the next.
Working with AI follows the exact same pattern.
As you add details, correct weak spots, and improve the draft,
the AI has better material to question, evaluate, and improve.
Let's track a business plan across two rounds.
In the early round, you say, give me ideas for a summer business.
The AI answers, here are some ideas.
Lawn care, pet sitting, tutoring, car washing, and selling crafts online.
In the later round, you say, I'm considering a lawn cutting business.
I'll serve homes within biking distance, use the customer's mower,
work weekday afternoons, and charge by lawn size.
Help me find weaknesses in the plan and improve it.
The AI answers, let's pressure test it.
How will you quote lawn sizes?
What happens when it rains?
The next level starts after the first answer.
Think, learn, start, and iterate with AI.
